notes.title: We have a release date for Grunn!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Developer Tom here :) And I bring good news!

My game Grunn is launching on PC via Steam on October 4th!! We made the announcement today at the Fantastic Games Fest in Austin. Here is the trailer:

[previewyoutube=ko2IfE7NLvM;full][/previewyoutube]

As a reminder, Grunn is a game about gardening, and it is normal. Trim the grass, water the flowers, pick up trash, and of course enjoy the lovely scenery of the dutch countryside. Maybe you feel like you’re being watched, but that’s probably your imagination, right? Oh and don’t forget to trim the hedges!

Another cool thing: The Grunn demo won the Digital Moment Award at this year’s A MAZE fest! Woah!

Thanks again to everyone who has shown their support for Grunn since the announcement, I am very excited to see you all experiencing the full game in a few weeks!

Happy gardening < : ●)

Tom

notes.title: Small patch: added some new settings!
notes.notes:
A couple people reported that they got dizzy and/or nauseous when playing Grunn, so I added some new settings: 


 Wobbly effect: Toggles on/off the effect that makes everything slightly move & appear dreamy/wobbly.
 Pixel smoothing: Toggles on/off the fuzzy smoothing effect of pixels.
 Pixel scale: You can increase this to make the game appear less chunky, more smooth.
 Font type: Added 2 new fonts that are hopefully a bit more legible, please feel free to let me know if this helps, I can always add more fonts!

You can find all of these new settings in the title screen or when pausing the game, under 'settings'.

Some other things you can try against getting dizzy (also in settings):

 Increase the field of view.
 Decrease the color shift value.

One other thing: There were also reports of the game looking incredibly fuzzy and weirdly low-res on ultra wide monitors, and I believe I've also fixed this issue!

Thanks for playing my demo :) Let me know if this helps or if there is anything else I can add that could improve the experience! 

-Tom
